create_google_secret_manager_client: create a GoogleSecretManager client with a project ID and optional refresh interval
retrieve_secret_from_google_secret_manag: retrieve a secret from Google Secret Manager by name using cached or live fetch
configure_secret_manager_cache: configure in-memory cache with TTL for Google Secret Manager secret values
set_always_read_secret_manager: set GoogleSecretManager to always bypass cache and read directly from Google Secret Manager
register_secret_manager_with_litellm: register a GoogleSecretManager instance as the global litellm secret manager client
